about.blurb: Explore the wild Hanninah Valley in Canada's North West, looking for the missing students of Dr. Nadelmann's expedition, in this unofficial scenario for Arkham Horror: The Card Game.

credits.role: Scenario design, card design & English translation

{action}: _Investigate_. If you succeed, take control of the Expedition Notebook.

sarceeTerritory.persuade: {action}: _Parley_. Test {intellect} (6). You can spend up to 5 resources to reduce the difficulty of this test by as many points. You try to convince Imala that you only want her and her husband to be safe.
sarceeTerritory.intimidate: {action}: _Parley_. Test {combat} (3). You're trying to intimidate Imala in order to make her confess where her husband is hiding. Record that the Sarcee are hunting you down.
